description: A minecart on a straight rail with three powered rails: pushed along by holding forward (the server moves it), up to a stone block at the end, back with forward held facing west; sneaking off; then a llama mounted with /ride (the rider turned to face as it does); sneaking off.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
